newsitem.title: USA: Unison to "vigorously" defend against suits.
newsitem.headline: Unison to "vigorously" defend against suits.

text.p: Unison HealthCare Corp said Wednesday that recent lawsuits relating to the decline in the company's stock price would be vigorously defended.
The company said that while such lawsuits are common when there is a decline in stock price, it would take these lawsuits seriously and defend against them to protect its reputation.
Unison stock is trading at 2-3/4, while having reached a 52-week high of 15-1/2.
The company added that its defense of these lawsuits will in no way interfere with the resolution of its accounting system problems.

Unisys has said that it will have to restate its earnings for the first three quarters of 1996. It is facing legal challenges from an investor who has accused the company, its officers and directors of omitting material facts about its performance.
Unison provides a broad range of health care services including nursing care, rehabilitation therapy, pharmacy and other specialized services primarily to subacute patients.
